description: Permanently revoke an owned share. Later downloads fail. This cannot be undone and does not delete the file. Requires your API key.

api_key.description: Secret API key from signup. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass this only when you cannot set headers. Do not write it into a file you share.

grant_id.description: grant_id of the share to revoke.

name: revoke_share
title: Revoke a share
